# Spec: WF-20 — Show "Download" instead of "Export" on the export action

Status: Draft
Ticket: WF-20
Change kind: Modify
Supersedes: N/A
Approved by: —
Approved at: —

## Objective
Change the text on the existing export action from "Export" to "Download". Pressing the action must still work exactly as it does today. Nothing else changes: the constant name `LABEL`, the `click` signature, how it calls the callback, and other UI text all stay as they are. Localization is out of scope; the label is a single hard-coded string (ui.py:1) and the repository has no translation layer.

Source: ticket WF-20 as stated by the owner ("change the existing export label from Export to Download and preserve the existing callback behavior. No other behavior changes").

## Change Impact
- Modified behavior: the value of `ui.LABEL` (ui.py:1) changes from "Export" to "Download" (REQ-001).
- Explicitly preserved behavior: `ui.click(callback)` (ui.py:2-3) calls `callback` once with no arguments and lets any exception through; nothing else about it changes (REQ-002).
- Who has to change with it: verify.py:2 checks `LABEL == "Export"` and must be updated to check "Download". The repository has no other consumers of `LABEL`; all files were checked.
- Compatibility/migration constraints: none. No stored data, schema, public contract or external consumer depends on the label text.

## Requirements

### Requirement: REQ-001 — The export action shows "Download"
Source: ticket WF-20 ("change the existing export label from Export to Download")

The UI module MUST set the export action label `ui.LABEL` to exactly "Download", and MUST NOT use the old text "Export".

#### Scenario: Label shows the new text
- GIVEN the `ui` module after this change
- WHEN `LABEL` is read
- THEN it equals "Download"

#### Scenario: Old text is gone
- GIVEN the `ui` module after this change
- WHEN `LABEL` is compared with "Export"
- THEN they are not equal

### Requirement: REQ-002 — Clicking the action still calls the callback as before
Source: ticket WF-20 ("preserve the existing callback behavior"); current behavior at ui.py:2-3

When `click(callback)` is called, the UI module MUST call `callback` exactly once with no arguments, as it does today.

#### Scenario: Callback runs once
- GIVEN `calls = []` and a callback `lambda: calls.append(1)`
- WHEN `click(callback)` is called
- THEN `calls == [1]`

#### Scenario: Callback exception passes through unchanged
- GIVEN a callback that raises `RuntimeError`
- WHEN `click(callback)` is called
- THEN the same `RuntimeError` reaches the caller (`click` does not catch it, ui.py:3)

## Testing Strategy
- Test file: verify.py, which uses plain `assert` and is the repository's existing verification precedent. Command: `python3 verify.py` (AGENTS.md:1). The command was found in source and not run during /spec.
- REQ-001: change verify.py:2 to `assert LABEL == "Download"`. Before the change to ui.py this check fails (LABEL is still "Export"); after it, the check passes.
- REQ-002: keep verify.py:3-5 (`calls == [1]`) unchanged; it must pass both before and after the change. Add a check that an exception raised by the callback reaches the caller of `click`.
- Done when `python3 verify.py` exits 0.
